🎥🎬: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth (2026)

Cliff Booth has always been the kind of man who can handle trouble, but his latest chapter takes him somewhere completely different. Set in 1977 Los Angeles, Brad Pitt returns as the legendary stuntman, now working behind the scenes as a fixer for Hollywood’s most influential figures.

His latest assignment introduces him to a world of ambitious agents, famous television stars, ruthless gangsters, and criminal secrets. When a seemingly ordinary job spirals into murder, blackmail, and extortion, Cliff must once again prove that there’s more to him than meets the eye.

Directed by David Fincher and written by Quentin Tarantino, this new chapter brings Cliff Booth back into the spotlight.
